items.title: The death toll from heavy rains and flooding in Pakistan since June increases to 107 people killed and at least 344 others injured.
Federal Reserve rate decision: raised by 0.25 point, to a 5.25-5.50% target range (effective 2023-07-27)
M 7.0 - 11 km NE of Bantay, Philippines
Bangladesh reports a record for the second consecutive day of 258 deaths from COVID-19, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 19,779.

Indonesia reports a record 47,128 recoveries and 2,069 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of recoveries to 2.596 million and the nationwide death toll to 86,835.
M 7.0 - 234 km W of Abepura, Indonesia
Over 100 people are killed and around 1,500 injured in a violent crackdown against protesters in the Egyptian capital of Cairo.
At least 150 people are killed as clashes continue between radical Islamists in northern Nigeria after two days of unrest.

A series of bomb blasts have rocked the Christian districts of the city of Ambon in Indonesia in what appears to be a continuation of violence between Christian and Muslim inhabitants. Over the past five years more than 5000 people have been killed in this conflict.
